_README: This is the template for the denial-code library at /denial-codes.
To turn the library on: fill this in, save it as src/content/denial-codes.json
(drop the _README key), and restart the build. The hub, one page per code, the
sitemap entries, the footer and Resources links and the permanent redirect from
/denial-reason-explorer all switch on together. Nothing else needs editing.
Every field is validated by src/data/denial-codes.ts and a bad entry fails the
build rather than shipping a broken page. The prose fields (intro, meaning,
whoPays, group meaning) take either one string or an array of strings, one per
paragraph. commonCauses, howToFix and howToPrevent are arrays of bullets and
need at least one item each. relatedReading may be omitted or left empty.
The example entry below is structure only. Replace every TODO with real copy;
Field limits: title <= 160, metaDescription <= 320, h1 <= 160, slug lowercase
and hyphenated, relatedService must be a path on this site starting with /.
